messages:
diane.m: Scheduling Oakridge dedicated slice staged swap for Tue 2026-03-24 02:00 UTC. Need go/no-go + KMS overlap check. CC @kai @sam-ops

kai: Thanks — can we confirm the version pin and whether the hotfix patch (v1.14.2-hotfix) is included? Also flagging KV cache priming window.

deploy-bot: (/deploy) Received schedule request: tenant=oakridge time=2026-03-24T02:00:00Z initiated_by=diane.m
deploy-bot: Proposed image: redwood/inference:v1.14.2-hotfix (sha256:8a7f2c)

sam-ops: KMS overlap: oakridge's CMK rotation scheduled 2026-03-24T02:30Z in their account — we need to avoid collision. Recommend keep rotate=false for this cutover.

diane.m: Agreed. We'll pin to v1.14.2-hotfix and set --kms-rotate=false. Also want to prime KV cache for predicted peak prefixes 10m before swap.

qa-lead: Quick perf note: the hotfix fixes a regression in attention caching but we only validated up to seq_len=2048. If customer uses longer sequences we should keep canary slices for 2h.

releasemgr: Proposed rollout plan:
- 02:00 UTC: staged swap on 20% traffic (slice-a) 
- 02:10 UTC: monitor p50/p95 and error rate for 10m
- 02:20 UTC: shift to 50% (slice-b)
- 02:40 UTC: full cutover if stable
Rollback criteria: p95 > 600ms OR error_rate increase > 1.5x baseline OR KV miss spike > 2x

kai: Adding commands I'm going to run during the window:
```bash
# schedule deploy
deployctl schedule --tenant oakridge --when 2026-03-24T02:00Z --image redwood/inference:v1.14.2-hotfix --kms-rotate=false --pin-version
# prime KV cache (run from ops jumpbox)
kv-prime --tenant oakridge --prefixes ./oakridge-prefixes.txt --concurrency 8 --start 2026-03-24T01:50Z
```

diane.m: Perfect. Can someone paste the short rollback command we can copy to runbook?

releasemgr: Rollback command (hot swap to previous image):
```bash
deployctl rollback --tenant oakridge --to-image redwood/inference:v1.14.1 --reason "post-cutover regression" --force-if-degraded
```
Set immediate traffic hold if thresholds hit: `routingctl hold --tenant oakridge`

deploy-bot: Action items created: RB-4821 (pin image/v1.14.2-hotfix), RB-4822 (KV prime job), RB-4823 (canary monitor alert). Scheduled job id: 642199.

elaine: I added release notes and customer-facing summary: https://redwood-internal/relnotes/2026-03-24-oakridge. It includes the hotfix description + known-limitations about seq_len.

sam-ops: Ops acknowledgement: I'll be on-call for the window and reachable on pager. Prepared circuit-breaker thresholds in the console and verified the fallback model variant exists. :thumbsup:

qa-lead: I'll run a short regression suite 30m prior and then a smoke post-20% cutover. Will post results in this thread.

kai: One more ask — please confirm that the tenant's dedicated pool has capacity reservation for the swap. If not, we'll need a short burst reservation for 30m.

diane.m: @infra-scheduling confirmed reserve=2 gpus for 03/24 01:45-03:00 UTC. I've updated the runbook.

releasemgr: Final: pin to v1.14.2-hotfix, kms-rotate=false, KV prime at 01:50Z, canary 20%->50%->100% with monitors and rollback thresholds as listed. Everyone ack?

diane.m: ack

kai: ack

sam-ops: ack

deploy-bot: deploy schedule confirmed: id=642199 tenant=oakridge time=2026-03-24T02:00Z image=v1.14.2-hotfix kms_rotate=false

qa-lead: Posting quick smoke results: preflight suite PASSED (latency within baseline). Will update after 20% slice.

releasemgr: Leaving the thread open for any late blockers. If no objections by 2026-03-23 18:00 UTC we'll proceed as planned.

elaine: I'll circulate the concise customer advisory and include rollback contact list. Link posted in runbook.

sam-ops: 👍 will be standing by.
